# Enhance Ability (`spells:enhance-ability`)
**Level 2 [Transmutation](../magic-schools/transmutation.md) (Concentration)** | **Casting Time:** Action | **Range:** Touch
**Components:** V, S, M (fur or a feather) | **Duration:** up to 1 hour | **Classes:** [Bard](../classes/bard.md), [Cleric](../classes/cleric.md), [Druid](../classes/druid.md), [Ranger](../classes/ranger.md), [Sorcerer](../classes/sorcerer.md), [Wizard](../classes/wizard.md)

You touch a creature and choose Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. For the duration, the target has Advantage on ability checks using the chosen ability.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2. You can choose a different ability for each target.
